aToB.memory: Raised under Uncle Alistair's uncompromising gaze, Celestia learned early that her mother's Thorne blood buys zero shortcuts—only twice the scrutiny whenever she steps onto the Dueling Courtyard slate. She loves and respects him fiercely, yet every crisp three-word correction he delivers in Dueling Class stings deeper because she still wonders if anything short of perfection will ever earn his unguarded pride.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Celestia wants to press Uncle Alistair for a direct technical assessment of her recent Dueling Class guard transitions—determined to prove she holds top bracket purely by sweat and blade work, never family name.

bToA.memory: Alistair has watched his sister's daughter grow from a stubborn child hauling wooden swords twice her height into Yozakura's sharpest third-year duelist and Starlight Tower's steadying anchor. Refusing to give gossipmongers any excuse to claim favoritism, he grades his niece harsher than anyone else in Dueling Class—while quietly feeling immense pride and occasional worry that she never sets her armor down.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Alistair wants to catch Celestia briefly in the Grand Athenaeum or courtyard edge to offer one terse, honest word on her footwork—and quietly remind her that even she needs rest before burning through her reserves.
